name: roman_desk_01
subject: a plain sturdy Roman wooden writing table: a rectangular tabletop on four simple turned legs, warm shadow-brown wood (#B09878) with sand-tone (#E8D8C0) highlights along the top edge and clean plank lines, completely bare on top — no clutter, no objects, nothing on it, no ground or floor beneath
notes: Frontinus desk base; lamp/scrolls/tablets composite ON TOP in AE. Used in 6 framing scenes (Roman kit).

name: frontinus_01
subject: an older Roman man (Sextus Julius Frontinus) seated and bent slightly forward in a reading pose, shown in 3/4 view facing right: a lined stern face with a short cropped grey Roman haircut and a clean-shaven jaw, calm authority in the brow; wearing a cream wool (#FAF7F2) senatorial toga draped over one shoulder with a single broad terracotta (#B85C38) vertical stripe (the latus clavus) down the front; one mitten hand resting forward as if on a document
notes: The witness/spine of video 001 — MUST be the same FILE across all 8 scenes he appears in (consistency gate). Seated; pairs with roman_desk_01. Roman kit.

name: oil_lamp_01
subject: a single small Roman bronze oil lamp — a low rounded oil reservoir with a pinched pouring spout and a little arched handle — with a small warm flame at the spout casting a soft warm glow, warm metallic bronze rendered in sand (#E8D8C0) highlight over shadow-brown (#B09878); nothing else, no table, no ground
notes: Frontinus's night light; key the glow warm and upper-left in AE. Composites on roman_desk_01. Used in 2 scenes. Roman kit.

name: scroll_stack_01
subject: a small neat stack of rolled papyrus scrolls lying together, warm cream (#FAF7F2) and sand (#F0D8B0) paper with shadow-brown (#B09878) rolled ends, one or two scrolls slightly askew on the pile; nothing else around them, no table, no ground
notes: Desk dressing for the Frontinus scenes; composite on the desk. Used in 3 scenes. Roman kit.

name: wax_tablet_01
subject: a small stack of Roman wax writing tablets — flat rectangular boards with shadow-brown (#B09878) wooden frames around recessed dark charcoal (#2C2C2C) wax centres — with a thin bronze stylus resting diagonally on top; nothing else, no table, no ground
notes: Frontinus's aqueduct ledger prop; composite on the desk. Used in 1 scene. Roman kit.

name: crowd_tourists_01
subject: a small tight cluster of four to five present-day tourists standing together as scale figures at a monument: simple muted figures in desaturated casual modern clothes (sand #E8D8C0 and sage #9C9F77 tones), one figure raising a phone to take a photo, another looking up; a compact quiet group meant to read as human scale, not as the focus
notes: Human-scale reference at the Pont du Gard ('it's huge' beats). Keep muted/low-contrast so it reads as scale. Used in 3 scenes. Roman kit.

name: olive_tree_01
subject: a single gnarled old olive tree: a short twisted shadow-brown (#B09878) trunk splitting into a few crooked branches beneath a broad soft silver-sage (#9C9F77) canopy of small leaves, dry and desaturated; no ground line, nothing else
notes: Garrigue dressing; duplicate / rescale / flip in AE for groves. Used in 6 scenes. Roman kit.

name: cypress_01
subject: a single tall narrow Mediterranean cypress: a slim vertical column of dark sage-green foliage (#9C9F77 deepened toward #6F7355) tapering to a point at the top, a short shadow-brown (#B09878) trunk at the base, dry and desaturated; no ground line, nothing else
notes: Vertical garrigue accent; duplicate at varied heights in AE. Used in 3 scenes. Roman kit.

name: surveyor_01
subject: a lean weathered Roman workman (a libratore / surveyor) crouched low in a sighting pose shown in side profile facing right, one arm extended forward as if lining up a level: bare-headed with short dark hair, sun-weathered, wearing a plain undyed knee-length short tunic (#F0D8B0) belted with a simple rope, bare shins; a focused, concentrated expression
notes: The 'how they held the slope' figure — same FILE across all 9 scenes. Pairs with chorobates_01. Rig with puppet pins for the sighting lean. Faces RIGHT. Roman kit.

name: chorobates_01
subject: a Roman chorobates levelling instrument: a long narrow wooden bench/table (~6 m) on four splayed legs, a single straight water-filled groove running the whole length of the flat top with a thin electric-azure (#1CA3E0) water line sitting in that groove, and a vertical plumb-line with a small hanging weight at EACH END checked against a marked notch on the leg; warm wood (shadow-brown #B09878 with sand #E8D8C0 highlights) and small bronze fittings
notes: The STAR instrument, accuracy-critical: water groove along the top + a plumb-line at EACH end (visual_facts). Groove water = azure. Used in 8 scenes. Roman kit.

name: survey_stake_01
subject: a single upright wooden survey stake / grading pole with a pointed foot driven into nothing, and one clearly marked horizontal height-notch band near the top (a painted charcoal #2C2C2C ring on the pale wood); plain wood, shadow-brown (#B09878) with sand (#E8D8C0) highlights; nothing else
notes: Grading target the surveyor sights to; duplicate along a survey line in AE. Used in 2 scenes. Roman kit.

name: groma_01
subject: a Roman groma surveying instrument: a vertical wooden staff planted upright, topped by a horizontal equal-armed cross, a small plumb-bob hanging on a string from EACH of the four arm-ends, and the cross mounted on a short sideways offset bracket so the cross sits beside — not directly on top of — the staff; wood with bronze fittings (shadow-brown #B09878, sand #E8D8C0)
notes: For straight lines / right angles: 4 plumb-bobs + the offset bracket are the accuracy cues (visual_facts). Used in 2 scenes. Roman kit.

name: dioptra_01
subject: a Roman dioptra surveying instrument: a horizontal sighting tube / flat sighting bar (alidade) mounted across a geared circular graduated disc, the disc set on top of a wooden tripod stand; more intricate and geared than a simple level, with bronze fittings and a graduated ring; wood and bronze (shadow-brown #B09878, sand #E8D8C0, fine #2C2C2C detailing)
notes: Angle-measuring instrument; least iconic of the three, used sparingly. Used in 1 scene. Roman kit.

name: surveyor_02
subject: a Roman workman standing upright and holding a tall vertical survey stake beside him with one mitten hand, shown in side profile facing left: bare-headed with short dark hair, wearing a plain undyed knee-length short tunic (#F0D8B0) with a rope belt, bare shins; an attentive posture looking ahead down the line
notes: The stake-holder who pairs with surveyor_01 across the valley (STAGE-1 opposing sides). Same FILE across 3 scenes. Faces LEFT (surveyor_01 faces right). Roman kit.
